stop_conditions.rule: the authors' stop rule: if OpenAlex (or another comparator) would lead RBAi Scholar on a measure where the paper says RBAi Scholar leads, report before any text changes. leads_reversed: a Table 2 measure whose published leader among the seven usable systems is an RBAi mode and whose round-2 leader is not; rbai_leads_lost: a paired comparison of the paper whose published difference favoured RBAi Scholar and whose round-2 difference does not (against_upper_bound marks the comparisons with an OpenAlex upper bound, not a usable system); significant_against_rbai: a round-2 difference against RBAi Scholar with Holm-adjusted P below 0.05.
